name: Blackjack
author: Alessandro Pistella
description: Blackjack by Alessandro Pistella: embodied AI with Arduino VENTUNO Q, Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8, App Lab and ROS 2 on Waveshare UGV02. Architecture and measured experiments.
headline:
From neural models
to physical action.
intro: What does useful onboard intelligence look like when models, robotics software and real hardware have to work as one system?
hero_alt: CAD-based render of Blackjack on its UGV02 chassis, with the optional roof turret
hero_caption: Blackjack design render, shown with the optional turret. Hardware procurement is next.
about: Blackjack is my systems-engineering project for embodied AI: select useful pretrained models, deploy them through the Qualcomm and Arduino ecosystem, connect them to a robot, and measure the complete behaviour. Arduino VENTUNO Q brings Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 and an STM32H5F5 together; Waveshare UGV02 provides the mobile platform. ROS 2 gives the experiments a common interface and a conventional baseline. The investigation spans perception, language, context and bounded autonomous action, with latency, energy and thermal behaviour recorded alongside task outcomes.
bio: Technology executive and engineer with twenty years of bringing embedded and connected systems into production, including Edge AI. My role in Blackjack is system architecture and technical direction: connect the use case to a compute platform, define the software and hardware boundaries, make the trade-offs, and turn each experiment into evidence for the next decision. I own the integration from model deployment to physical behaviour. Robotics is also where I keep exploring and having fun.
